review: Whole coach and coupling fit within frame; class-specific windows and underfloor detail visible.
Curtain folds, quilt seams, berth framing, panel, table and mirror remain intact and legible; fine Monte Carlo grain remains.
Square-window 2A arrangement is distinct from first AC; full body/buffers framed, underfloor gear and entrance detail visible; fine grain remains.

Two-tier berth arrangement, upper safety rails, ladders, lower support bases, curtains, reading lights, table and bottle holders read clearly. Fine Monte Carlo grain remains, especially in shadow; no denoising used.
Broad rectangular three-tier sealed windows distinguish this class. Full exterior and coupler framing preserved; class markings and underfloor equipment readable. Fine Monte Carlo grain remains.

Day-mode three-tier bay shows folded middle-berth backrests, support chains, ladders, upper guards and broad window. Table, bottle holders and wall reading lights remain legible. Fine Monte Carlo grain persists, no denoising.

Non-AC barred windows, varied louvred shutters and low roof vents distinguish the second-sitting branch. Interior seats visible through open windows; full coach and coupling fit in frame. Fine grain remains.

Individual 3+3 second-sitting seats, open luggage racks, barred shutters and paired ceiling fans read clearly. Aisle remains open, class topology distinct from GS benches. Fine grain remains without denoising.
Chair-car class signage and sealed-window AC branch remain legible; full body, buffers, coupling, steps and underfloor gear are contained in frame. Fine grain remains without denoising.
High-backed 3+2 chair-car seating with separate armrests and linen headrest covers reads clearly. Curtains, racks, overhead fans and open aisle visible. Fine grain remains without denoising.
Sleeper signage and non-AC barred/shutter window arrangement remain clear. Full framing includes roof vents, entrance steps, coupling, bogies and underfloor equipment; residual fine grain remains.

Day-mode sleeper bay shows folded middle-berth backrests, support chains, guarded upper berths, ladders and barred shutter windows. Table, bottle holders and lower supports visible; fine grain remains.

General-second signage, barred shutter windows and low ventilators are visible. Coach body, steps, bogies and uncoupled buffers/coupler fit inside frame. Interior bench silhouettes visible through openings; fine grain remains.

Continuous general-class benches and connected standing grab frames clearly distinguish this selected GS subtype from 2S individual seats. Open racks, paired fans, barred/shutter windows and aisle visible; fine grain remains.

Disclosed corridor-wall/door cutaway shows complete four-berth first-AC compartment, upper guards/supports, quilted cushions, armrests, table, mirror, panel and full-height privacy shell. Fine grain remains.

Hindi and English first-AC class labels are legible and fully framed above sealed windows. Roof seam, drip rail and contrasting blue bands visible. Representative illustrative markings; fine grain remains in glass.

Two-tier side berth with no middle berth, gathered privacy curtains, paired access ladders and visible upper supports. Lower plinth and berth separation remain readable. Fine grain persists, especially shadowed underside.
Side-berth upper bracing, paired access ladders and lower plinth are visible. Broad sealed glazing and adjacent folded-middle-berth hardware distinguish the selected 3A layout. Fine grain remains.

Close chair-car view shows white linen covers, blue seat contours, armrests, gathered curtains, curtain rings and open luggage racks. Repeated rows retain the selected 3+2 arrangement. Fine grain remains.

Disclosed lavatory cutaway shows Western-style pan, floor drain, hose and adjacent washbasin. Door-attached controls/labels are hidden with removed door; fixed frame hardware remains. Sanitary layout is representative rather than an exact numbered-coach arrangement. Fine grain remains.
